input:
EARLIER SCENES (context only):
有一天孟子去了墓地玩儿，但是他妈妈觉得这是不合适的地方让孩子玩，所以她决定了他们会搬家找更好的地方。她恐怕儿子的童年不会幸福，而且住在这儿教育不太好。因为她望子成龙，所以她会一直搬家才能找到质量好的教育。然后他们搬到了离城市更近的地方。
他们住才一月就又搬家。古代的时候，一般人不喜欢卖东西的人。但是孟子老是跟这些卖东西的人常常玩儿，害得妈妈着急得很，因为她恐怕儿子会成为跟他们很像。她告诉了孟子：他们不是朋友，而是不好的人。
CURRENT SCENE:
你不是当数学家，而是当哲学家，不能当卖东西的人。所以他们又搬家。在他们第三个家，孟子学了怎么祭拜。妈妈感觉这个地方适合他们，告诉了孟子：我们找到了最后的家。在这儿妈妈让儿子从早到晚学习，他难怪成为有名的哲学家。

FLAGGED PLACES:

[P65] 你【不是】当数学家
  proposed by the AI checker: 你[不是→不要]当数学家 (advice/prohibition needs 不要, not 不是)
  her past correction (not_but_refutation): 他那[不是成为→没有当]医生 — her note: “不是……而是……” is used to refute something conventional and affirm something unexpected, and to correct something wrong
  her past correction (time_sequence_markers): 他难怪[+后来]成为了一个很聪明的哲学家
  her past correction (near_synonym_precision): 不是当哲学家就是当[商家→商人]
  rule card not_but_refutation: Use 不是……而是…… only to correct a conventional or mistaken idea with an unexpected alternative. Put the subject before 不是……而是…… when both alternatives have the same subject. Not an error: Do not flag a sentence that genuinely corrects a mistaken or conventional idea with an unexpected alternative. Do not use this pattern merely to connect two unrelated actions, places, or ideas.
  rule card time_sequence_markers: Use Time + 以后 after a completed time or action to show “after”; when moving to a later event in the story, use 后来 or 然后 rather than 以后 by itself. Do not add 以后 when the time phrase already says the time clearly. Not an error: Do not use 结果 merely as a general later-time connector; it is for an unexpected result. Use 后来 for a later development instead.

[P66] 【而是】当哲学家
  proposed by the AI checker: [而是→而要]当哲学家 (不要 should pair with 而要 in this contrast)
  her past correction (fixed_expressions): 而是成为[哲学人→哲学家]
  her past correction (le_completed): 他成为[+了]哲学家
  her past correction (become_and_profession): 也[成为大哲学→成为了大哲学家]
  rule card fixed_expressions: Use established fixed expressions and compounds, rather than literal or self-created word combinations. For example, use 自然规律, 制定规定, and 从 + Place. Not an error: Do not flag 人山人海 when it describes a scene where many people are gathered in a space.
  rule card le_completed: Use 了 for an action completed in the narrative or for a change of state (了completed). Do not use 了 merely because there is an action verb. Not an error: Do not flag an action just because it has a verb: if it is not about completion, no 了. An ongoing action can use 着 instead of 了.

[P67] 而是当哲学家【^】
  proposed by the correction model: 而是当哲学家[+的]
  her past correction (fixed_expressions): 而是成为[哲学人→哲学家]
  her past correction (le_completed): 他成为[+了]哲学家
  her past correction (time_sequence_markers): 他[+后来]成为哲学家
  rule card fixed_expressions: Use established fixed expressions and compounds, rather than literal or self-created word combinations. For example, use 自然规律, 制定规定, and 从 + Place. Not an error: Do not flag 人山人海 when it describes a scene where many people are gathered in a space.
  rule card le_completed: Use 了 for an action completed in the narrative or for a change of state (了completed). Do not use 了 merely because there is an action verb. Not an error: Do not flag an action just because it has a verb: if it is not about completion, no 了. An ongoing action can use 着 instead of 了.

[P68] 所以他们又搬家【^】
  proposed by the correction model: 所以他们又搬家[+了]
  her past correction (addition_repetition_connectors): 所以他们[再搬家→又搬家了] — her note: 又for something already occurred
  her past correction (addition_repetition_connectors): 所以他们[再→又]搬家一次 — her note: 又for something already occurred
  her past correction (le_completed): 所以他们再[搬家一次→搬了一次家] — her note: 了completed
  rule card addition_repetition_connectors: Use 又 for something that happened again, 也 for similarity, 还 for an added or surprising point, and 并 to make an addition more coherent. Put 也 after the subject (Subj.也), and put 又 before a modal V. (又+ modal V.). Not an error: Do not add an additive connector when the sentence does not show repetition, similarity, or an added point. Use 就, not 还, for a natural continuation rather than a surprising or angry one.
  rule card le_completed: Use 了 for an action completed in the narrative or for a change of state (了completed). Do not use 了 merely because there is an action verb. Not an error: Do not flag an action just because it has a verb: if it is not about completion, no 了. An ongoing action can use 着 instead of 了.

[P69] 在他们第三个家【^】
  proposed by the AI checker: 在他们第三个家[+里] (a modified 家 usually needs 里 for a location)
  her past correction (collocation_selection): 在[第三个房子→第三个地方]
  her past correction (numeral_measure_word_order): 他们[搬家三次→搬了三次家]以后 — her note: 了completed, V. + Num. + MW. + Obj.
  her past correction (near_synonym_precision): 他们⟦才搬了三次家⟧ — her note: 才 + Num. to express “small, few”, but here搬了三次家 is a large quantity
  rule card collocation_selection: Use words with their normal collocations: a word must naturally match the noun, person, thing, action, or situation it describes. A grammatically possible combination may still sound unnatural in Chinese.
  rule card numeral_measure_word_order: With a number and measure word, use Num. + MW. + noun directly, with no 的. For actions, use V. + Num. + MW. + Obj.; for a completed action, use 了completed, V. + Num. + MW. + Obj. Not an error: Do not use 们 or 些 with a number: use 三个男孩, not 三个男孩子们, and 那三个男孩, not 那些三个男孩.

[P70] 孟子学【^】了怎么祭拜
  proposed by the correction model: 孟子学[+会]了怎么祭拜
  her past correction (no_le_mental_state): 孟子⟦决定了⟧祭拜 — her note: 决定is a mental state verb, no了
  her past correction (perception_look_see): 孟母[一看→看到]孟子祭拜 — her note: 看look vs.看到see
  her past correction (first_mention_introduction): ⟦孟子⟧一直祭拜 — her note: better to briefly introduce “孟子” when this character first appears
  rule card no_le_mental_state: Mental-state verbs such as 决定 and 发现 normally do not take 了 when they express a decision or discovery in the narrative. Not an error: Apply this rule when 决定 or 发现 expresses the decision or discovery in this narrative use.
  rule card perception_look_see: 看 is “look”; 看到 is “see/catch sight of” and shows that the person actually sees something. Use 看到 when the narrative gives the result of seeing. Not an error: Do not flag 看 when the meaning is only “look,” rather than successfully seeing something. 看到 does not always need 了.

[P71] 告诉【了】孟子：我们找到了最后的家
  proposed by the correction model: 告诉[-了]孟子：我们找到了最后的家
  proposed by the teacher's pattern/rule: 告诉[-了]孟子：我们找到了最后的家 (no 了 after the speaking verb 告诉)
  her past correction (redundant_words): [-孟子的妈妈]告诉孟子 — her note: redundant
  her past correction (modal_and_control_verb_complements): 孟子的妈妈叫[-了]孟子搬家 — her note: 叫/让 is a modal verb, no了
  her past correction (le_completed): 所以妈妈跟孟子一起搬家[+了] — her note: 了completed
  rule card no_le_speaking_word: A speaking word that introduces quoted speech normally uses no particle, not 了.
  rule card redundant_words: Delete words, names, time phrases, or repeated structures when they add no new meaning or repeat information already given. For example, do not add 当 after 是, and do not use two words that express the same time or idea. Not an error: Do not delete a word if it adds a different meaning, such as a different time, person, or detail. Only flag words or structures that repeat information already expressed.

[P72] 【他难怪】成为有名的哲学家
  proposed by the AI checker: [他难怪→难怪他]成为有名的哲学家 (难怪 normally comes before the subject it explains)
  her past correction (word_class_choice): 难怪他成为[名的→有名的]哲学家
  her past correction (time_sequence_markers): 他难怪[+后来]成为了一个很聪明的哲学家
  her past correction (become_and_profession): 难怪他长大以后[当→成为]很有名的哲学家
  rule card word_class_choice: Choose the word class and form that the structure needs: use nouns as nouns, verbs as verbs, and Adj. where an adjective is needed. Follow fixed patterns such as 很多+noun and 这个 + Noun; 据说 goes at sentence initial, separate from the information heard. Not an error: Do not flag 文明 when it is used as an Adj. meaning “civilized.”
  rule card time_sequence_markers: Use Time + 以后 after a completed time or action to show “after”; when moving to a later event in the story, use 后来 or 然后 rather than 以后 by itself. Do not add 以后 when the time phrase already says the time clearly. Not an error: Do not use 结果 merely as a general later-time connector; it is for an unexpected result. Use 后来 for a later development instead.

places.reason: This is advice/prohibition, not a refutation.
It must pair with 不要 in this advice contrast.
当哲学家 is complete without 的.
The repeated move is a completed narrative event.
第三个家 can naturally function as the location here.
学了怎么祭拜 is grammatical and complete.
The speaking verb introducing direct quotation takes no 了.
This word order was accepted in her similar past correction.
